name: Netakiri na Boku wa Android no Kimi to Deau
original_name: 寝たきりな僕はアンドロイドの君と出会う
source:
Story: Japan, 2040.
13 years after a devastating earthquake submerged Tokyo under the ocean,
humanity is slowly rebuilding with the help of advanced technology.
One boy, stuck in a body that won't move, discovers joy again
when a robot avatar allows him to go shopping, get a job, and more.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE274229.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在2040年的日本。
一场毁灭性地震使东京沉入海底，距今已过去13年。
在先进技术的帮助下，人类正在缓缓重建家园。
一个因身体无法活动而卧床不起的少年，借助机器人替身，终于能够外出购物、工作，体验种种生活的可能，再次找回了快乐。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE274229.html]DLsite English[/url]]
